title: Separating Engineering Reasoning from DEXPI Serialization in LLM-Based Greenfield Surface-Process Design: A Three-Case Study for Underground Gas Storage
abstract: arXiv:2609.12656v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models can produce engineering descriptions and structured process representations, but standards-level serialization can substantially increase the generation burden. This diagnostic study examines whether separating engineering reasoning from Data Exchange in the Process Industry (DEXPI) serialization changes where representation and engineering failures occur in constrained greenfield surface-process design for underground gas storage. We compare Direct DEXPI generation with generation of a lightweight Engineering Intermediate Representation (IR) on three cases: single-pressure injection, withdrawal and export, and dual-pressure injection. All six conditions use one fixed model snapshot, qwen3.8-max-0902, with one completed hosted generation per condition. Direct outputs are XSD-valid in 2 of 3 cases, while all 3 Engineering IR outputs are structurally valid under a minimal validator. Direct prompt inputs contain approx

translated_title: 在基于大语言模型的绿地表面工艺设计中将工程推理与DEXPI序列化分离：面向地下储气的三案例研究
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型能够生成工程描述和结构化工艺表示，但标准级别的序列化会显著增加生成负担。这项诊断性研究考察了将工程推理与流程工业数据交换（DEXPI）序列化分离，是否会改变地下储气受限绿地表面工艺设计中表示失败与工程失败发生的位置。我们在三个案例上比较了直接DEXPI生成与轻量级工程中间表示（IR）的生成：单压力注入、采出与外输、以及双压力注入。所有六种条件均使用同一个固定模型快照qwen3.8-max-0902，每种条件完成一次托管生成。直接生成的输出在3个案例中有2个通过XSD有效性验证，而所有3个工程IR输出在最小验证器下均结构有效。直接提示词输入包含约
tldr: 在地下储气地面工艺设计中，将工程推理与DEXPI序列化解耦、改用轻量级工程中间表示，能提升输出的结构有效性，从而改变表示失败与工程失败的分布。
en_tdlr: Decoupling engineering reasoning from DEXPI serialization via a lightweight engineering intermediate representation improves structural validity and shifts where representation and engineering failures occur in LLM-based greenfield surface-process design for underground gas storage.
